bull_bear.body: Prioritizing working capital for inventory buildup amid supply chain disruptions; Debt used for MSME vendor financing (INR 171cr); No equity raise planned unless large acquisition (>30% of current size) emerges; Future demerger of brand business to unlock shareholder value.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Middle East conflict prolonging Red Sea route disruptions impacting 14% of revenue; Rising raw material costs (memory/CPU) outpacing price pass-through ability; Receivables bloating (21% of sales) if B2G payment cycles elongate; Dependency on Honeywell license renewal (March 2027); Execution risk in launching own brand in competitive US market.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident and ambitious; Emphasizes long-term institution building over quarterly noise; Acknowledges near-term logistics/cost headwinds but frames them as temporary; Strong focus on 'Make-in-India' sovereignty in surveillance/drones; Transparent about demerger plans and brand scaling logic.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: MSME vendor financing (INR 171cr) classified as short-term debt but carries low interest (~8.5%), distorting net debt perception; Own-brand 'Vertual' targets US air purifier market ($1B on Amazon alone) where Honeywell license is restricted; Surveillance shift from 'cameras' to 'data collection devices' with AI GPUs creates sticky B2G moat; Demerger timeline (15 months planning + 12-15 months execution) suggests value unlock event in FY28-29.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Distribution reach: omni-channel Pan-India network of 10,000+ channel partners, 18 warehouses with over 125,000 sq. ft., presence across 38+ countries, spanning General Trade, LFR, e-commerce, Quick Commerce, D2C and the Government e-Marketplace
- Switching costs / brand stickiness: many partner brands have appointed Creative Newtech as their exclusive partner and maintained associations for over five years, and the Company has secured long-running contracts with 26+ global brands
- Value-added market-entry capability beyond pure distribution — market intelligence, go-to-market strategy, brand positioning, demand generation and lifecycle support — described as setting it apart from conventional players
- Brand ownership / IP: authorised trademark licensee for Honeywell International Inc., exclusively manufacturing the Honeywell 'Electronic Essentials' range across South Asia, Southeast Asia, Middle East Asia & Africa, plus exclusive rights to manufacture and distribute CyberPowerPC customised gaming and high-performance PCs in India
- Service infrastructure: end-to-end warranty and post-warranty support, high-level repair services and response centres, reinforcing partner-brand confidence
- Supply-chain and customs advantage: AEO-T2 accreditation, Three Star Export House status, a Section 58 Private Bonded Warehouse at Bhiwandi, a modern Warehouse Management System and API integrations with logistics providers
- Channel enablement depth: one of the few large distributors conducting specialised training modules, workshops, demos and ground-level promotional activity for resellers
- Government market access through the GeM platform for large-scale public-sector technology opportunities
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

business.body: Brand Business: INR 370cr (14% of total, +50%+ growth target), split India INR 232cr/Overseas INR 138cr; Market Entry (Distribution): 86% of revenue, expanding into AI, drones, data centers; Honeywell categories: Air purifiers (#2 in India), accessories, audio, networking cables.

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body: Creative Newtech specialises in market entry and penetration for global technology brands in India's Information and Communication Technology distribution market, providing an integrated platform spanning market research and competitive assessment, imports, distribution, sales, marketing and after-sales support. Its omni-channel network spans online platforms, offline channels and retail trade, with a Pan-India network of 10,000+ channel partners, 18+ warehouses and presence across 38+ countries. The Company has evolved from a traditional distribution-led business into three complementary verticals — Market Entry Specialist, Brand Business (brand licensing, product development, contract manufacturing, sourcing and commercialisation) and Solutions (enterprise infrastructure, surveillance, cybersecurity, networking, collaboration and digital technologies for enterprise and government customers).
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Market Entry Specialist (distributed vendor brands):** AOC — Monitor & TV, Dahua Technology — Video Door Phone, Cricut — Smart Cutting Machines, Materials and Tools, Cooler Master — PC Casing and Cooling products, Honeywell — Air Purifier, Home Audio, Laptop Enhancement & Mobility products, Structured Cabling Systems, Lexar — Storage/ Memory Card, Zion — Memory, Storage, Instax Fujifilm — Cameras, Super Micro — Server and Processors, Ruark — Audio products - speakers, Lenco — Turntable and Speakers, OM Systems — Advance Imaging Cameras, CyberPower PC — Gaming PC, High Performance PC, Workstation and Business PC, PNY — Memory, Storage, Graphic and Networking, BRYT — Memory, Storage, Samsung — Monitors, Colorful — Computer, Motherboards, Graphic and Audio, Viewsonic — Projectors, 3D Glass, IFPD, Corsair — Memory, Storage, Rapoo — Computers & Accessories, Panzer Glass — Premium Mobile Covers and Accessories, INP — Computer & Tablets, Aabo Ring — Smart Ring, Sparsh — Surveillance, Matrix — Surveillance, Kaspersky — Cybersecurity, EIZO — Advance Monitoring, PDRL — Drone Technology
- **Brand Business (licensed / owned brands):** Honeywell 'Electronic Essentials' range under exclusive trademark licence — laptop, smartphone and TV enhancement products, Audio products, Air Purifiers (Air Touch P2/U1/U2/V1/V5, Move Pure 4 and Move Pure 5 Car Air Purifiers), Structured cabling systems
- **Solutions:** Enterprise infrastructure, Surveillance, Cybersecurity, Networking, Collaboration and digital technologies, Integrated Body-Worn Camera deployment, Disaster Management and Emergency Response Kits

latest_quarter.body: Q4/FY26 margins pressured by Red Sea logistics (freight up from $1.5k to $7.5k-$8k per container) and 30-40% rise in raw material costs (memory, CPUs); Brand margins expected to expand from 13% to 18-19% at scale due to operating leverage (manpower, marketing, logistics cost % reduction); Make-in-India surveillance offers higher gross margins but higher opex initially.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue growth: 25-30% CAGR over next 3-4 years; Brand business growth: 50-60% annually (FY27-28); Margins: Brand EBITDA currently ~13%, targeting 18-19% at INR 1,000cr scale; Order inflow: Strong in Make-in-India surveillance/AI; Capex: Minimal CAPEX required for own-brand launch (INR 10-12cr marketing), working capital funded via debt/internal accruals for next 15 months.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Not explicitly quantified; growth driven by B2G projects in surveillance/AI requiring extended credit terms; partner stocks in Middle East cover 45-60 days.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Launch of own brand 'Vertual' in US (Amazon-first) and India (May 22-23 start) to bypass licensing restrictions; Potential M&A in surveillance/AI drone space; Demerger of brand business in 2-3 years to unlock 30-40x multiples; Targeting 50:50 revenue split between brand and market entry by 2030.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

outlook.body:
- Three-pronged growth strategy: (1) strengthen leadership as a Market Entry Specialist, (2) new products and platforms — entry into the surveillance space via Sparsh and Matrix, (3) brand licensing and contract manufacturing, leveraging the Honeywell experience to target more brands.
- Strengthen the core Market Entry Specialist platform through market intelligence and go-to-market strategy, Pan-India distribution and channel development, brand positioning and market expansion, retail/enterprise/omnichannel enablement, sales and demand generation, and customer support and lifecycle management.
- Entry into intelligent surveillance by partnering Sparsh and Matrix — two of India's four STQC-certified surveillance brands — to build a portfolio of indigenous, government-compliant, AI-ready surveillance technologies and accelerate adoption through the nationwide channel ecosystem.
- Scale brand licensing and contract manufacturing as a 'key big bet and strategic growth lever', building on the exclusive Honeywell International Inc. trademark licence for the 'Electronic Essentials' range across South Asia, Southeast Asia, Middle East Asia and Africa, to target additional brands.
- Expand into high-value, higher-margin computing categories through CyberPowerPC, with exclusive rights to manufacture and distribute customised high-end gaming systems and high-performance PCs in India (designed in California, assembled in India) for gamers, AVGC-XR professionals, content studios, educational institutions, government agencies, enterprises and advanced users.
- Promote and distribute Made-in-India technology brands — e.g. the Zion memory and storage partnership — leveraging 31+ branches, presence across more than 195 cities and over 900+ partners to advance the Make in India vision.
- With Zion, deepen presence across India by expanding the partner network, strengthening engagement in emerging markets and supporting growing demand for AI-ready computing infrastructure.
- Broaden the Honeywell-licensed consumer portfolio into adjacent categories and smart features — car air purifiers, new home purifier models and Alexa integration across the Air Touch range.
- Pursue ongoing discussions with significant international brands to establish enduring partnerships and win distribution rights for additional brands.
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body:
- Global IT market growth and AI-led transformation: cloud adoption and AI are emerging as key growth engines, with businesses investing in scalable digital infrastructure and next-generation computing, creating sustained demand for hardware, networking, storage, peripherals and other technology products.
- Structural shift in the technology supply chain toward supply-chain diversification, regional manufacturing and localisation, with tariff-led changes encouraging alternative sourcing — creating opportunity for India in the global technology value chain.
- Asia-Pacific remained the largest regional IT market in 2025, strengthening the long-term opportunity for companies with established distribution networks and market-entry capabilities.
- India's technology sector resilience and continued digitalisation, rising AI adoption and expansion of technology infrastructure are expected to support increasing demand for computing, networking, storage and peripherals — a strong opportunity for Creative Newtech to expand its portfolio and strengthen its role as a market-entry and distribution partner for global technology brands.
- India surveillance/CCTV market growth driven by Smart Cities and Safe City initiatives, public-safety requirements and investments in airports, metros and critical infrastructure, with the industry moving to AI-enabled cameras and STQC requirements favouring indigenous manufacturing.
- India data-centre market expansion driven by cloud adoption, AI workloads and data localisation, raising requirements for high-performance computing, advanced networking, storage and AI-ready infrastructure.
- India AI market growth, with Generative AI, automation and predictive analytics driving demand for computing infrastructure, GPUs and data centres.
- India IoT adoption supported by 5G rollout, smart-city initiatives and Industrial IoT, supporting demand for connected devices, sensors, edge computing and intelligent monitoring.
- Brand-level demand strength: strong demand from brands such as Honeywell, Samsung, Cooler Master and ViewSonic supported growth during FY26.
- Government and industry initiatives accelerating India's orange economy, with AVGC-XR emerging as a priority growth sector — a demand driver for high-performance computing solutions for AI, game development, animation, VFX and 3D rendering.
- Consumer health and air-quality awareness driving the air purifier category from a lifestyle upgrade to a household necessity.
- Mix lever: a stated focus on enhancing operational efficiencies and expanding the portfolio of higher-margin, value-added products, with the CyberPowerPC partnership expanding presence in high-value, higher-margin categories.
- E-commerce and quick-commerce channel momentum for the Honeywell range, including availability on Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy, Amazon Now, Noon Minutes and Careem in India and the UAE.
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers

deepdive.thesis: Creative Newtech delivered strong FY26 growth (51% revenue, 32% PAT) driven by Honeywell brand scaling and new AI/surveillance verticals, but faces near-term margin pressure from Red Sea logistics costs and rising receivables due to extended credit in B2G segments. The strategic pivot toward owning brands (launching 'Vertual' in US/India) and potential demerger of the high-margin brand business in 2-3 years offers significant long-term value unlocking despite current supply chain headwinds.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Established in 1992, Creative Newtech is an Indian ICT distribution and market-entry specialist that helps global technology brands enter, establish and scale across India and international markets, and is associated with over 26+ renowned brands globally.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Creative Newtech specialises in market entry and penetration for global technology brands in India's Information and Communication Technology distribution market, providing an integrated platform spanning market research and competitive assessment, imports, distribution, sales, marketing and after-sales support. Its omni-channel network spans online platforms, offline channels and retail trade, with a Pan-India network of 10,000+ channel partners, 18+ warehouses and presence across 38+ countries. The Company has evolved from a traditional distribution-led business into three complementary verticals — Market Entry Specialist, Brand Business (brand licensing, product development, contract manufacturing, sourcing and commercialisation) and Solutions (enterprise infrastructure, surveillance, cybersecurity, networking, collaboration and digital technologies for enterprise and government customers).

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: Brand Business: INR 370cr (14% of total, +50%+ growth target), split India INR 232cr/Overseas INR 138cr; Market Entry (Distribution): 86% of revenue, expanding into AI, drones, data centers; Honeywell categories: Air purifiers (#2 in India), accessories, audio, networking cables.

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Market Entry Specialist (distributed vendor brands):** AOC — Monitor & TV, Dahua Technology — Video Door Phone, Cricut — Smart Cutting Machines, Materials and Tools, Cooler Master — PC Casing and Cooling products, Honeywell — Air Purifier, Home Audio, Laptop Enhancement & Mobility products, Structured Cabling Systems, Lexar — Storage/ Memory Card, Zion — Memory, Storage, Instax Fujifilm — Cameras, Super Micro — Server and Processors, Ruark — Audio products - speakers, Lenco — Turntable and Speakers, OM Systems — Advance Imaging Cameras, CyberPower PC — Gaming PC, High Performance PC, Workstation and Business PC, PNY — Memory, Storage, Graphic and Networking, BRYT — Memory, Storage, Samsung — Monitors, Colorful — Computer, Motherboards, Graphic and Audio, Viewsonic — Projectors, 3D Glass, IFPD, Corsair — Memory, Storage, Rapoo — Computers & Accessories, Panzer Glass — Premium Mobile Covers and Accessories, INP — Computer & Tablets, Aabo Ring — Smart Ring, Sparsh — Surveillance, Matrix — Surveillance, Kaspersky — Cybersecurity, EIZO — Advance Monitoring, PDRL — Drone Technology
- **Brand Business (licensed / owned brands):** Honeywell 'Electronic Essentials' range under exclusive trademark licence — laptop, smartphone and TV enhancement products, Audio products, Air Purifiers (Air Touch P2/U1/U2/V1/V5, Move Pure 4 and Move Pure 5 Car Air Purifiers), Structured cabling systems
- **Solutions:** Enterprise infrastructure, Surveillance, Cybersecurity, Networking, Collaboration and digital technologies, Integrated Body-Worn Camera deployment, Disaster Management and Emergency Response Kits

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- India (Pan-India, 10,000+ channel partners; General Trade, Large Format Retail, e-commerce, Quick Commerce, D2C websites and Government e-Marketplace)
- Presence across 38+ countries / distribution network in 38 countries
- Asia, the Middle East and Africa (served via international warehouses)
- South Asia, Southeast Asia, Middle East Asia & Africa (territory of the Honeywell trademark licence)
- Consumer and industrial segments
- Enterprises, institutions and government organisations

certifications.title: Quality certifications
certifications.body:
- ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (information security)
- ISO 20000-1:2018 (IT service management)
- RoHS (product compliance)
- AEO-T2 status accredited by the Directorate of International Customs, New Delhi
- Three Star Export House Certification
- Bhiwandi mother warehouse authorised as a Private Bonded Warehouse under Section 58 of the Customs Act, 1962

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: Not explicitly quantified; growth driven by B2G projects in surveillance/AI requiring extended credit terms; partner stocks in Middle East cover 45-60 days.

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.body: Revenue growth: 25-30% CAGR over next 3-4 years; Brand business growth: 50-60% annually (FY27-28); Margins: Brand EBITDA currently ~13%, targeting 18-19% at INR 1,000cr scale; Order inflow: Strong in Make-in-India surveillance/AI; Capex: Minimal CAPEX required for own-brand launch (INR 10-12cr marketing), working capital funded via debt/internal accruals for next 15 months.

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: Launch of own brand 'Vertual' in US (Amazon-first) and India (May 22-23 start) to bypass licensing restrictions; Potential M&A in surveillance/AI drone space; Demerger of brand business in 2-3 years to unlock 30-40x multiples; Targeting 50:50 revenue split between brand and market entry by 2030.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Global IT market growth and AI-led transformation: cloud adoption and AI are emerging as key growth engines, with businesses investing in scalable digital infrastructure and next-generation computing, creating sustained demand for hardware, networking, storage, peripherals and other technology products.
- Structural shift in the technology supply chain toward supply-chain diversification, regional manufacturing and localisation, with tariff-led changes encouraging alternative sourcing — creating opportunity for India in the global technology value chain.
- Asia-Pacific remained the largest regional IT market in 2025, strengthening the long-term opportunity for companies with established distribution networks and market-entry capabilities.
- India's technology sector resilience and continued digitalisation, rising AI adoption and expansion of technology infrastructure are expected to support increasing demand for computing, networking, storage and peripherals — a strong opportunity for Creative Newtech to expand its portfolio and strengthen its role as a market-entry and distribution partner for global technology brands.
- India surveillance/CCTV market growth driven by Smart Cities and Safe City initiatives, public-safety requirements and investments in airports, metros and critical infrastructure, with the industry moving to AI-enabled cameras and STQC requirements favouring indigenous manufacturing.
- India data-centre market expansion driven by cloud adoption, AI workloads and data localisation, raising requirements for high-performance computing, advanced networking, storage and AI-ready infrastructure.
- India AI market growth, with Generative AI, automation and predictive analytics driving demand for computing infrastructure, GPUs and data centres.
- India IoT adoption supported by 5G rollout, smart-city initiatives and Industrial IoT, supporting demand for connected devices, sensors, edge computing and intelligent monitoring.
- Brand-level demand strength: strong demand from brands such as Honeywell, Samsung, Cooler Master and ViewSonic supported growth during FY26.
- Government and industry initiatives accelerating India's orange economy, with AVGC-XR emerging as a priority growth sector — a demand driver for high-performance computing solutions for AI, game development, animation, VFX and 3D rendering.
- Consumer health and air-quality awareness driving the air purifier category from a lifestyle upgrade to a household necessity.
- Mix lever: a stated focus on enhancing operational efficiencies and expanding the portfolio of higher-margin, value-added products, with the CyberPowerPC partnership expanding presence in high-value, higher-margin categories.
- E-commerce and quick-commerce channel momentum for the Honeywell range, including availability on Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy, Amazon Now, Noon Minutes and Careem in India and the UAE.

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: Q4/FY26 margins pressured by Red Sea logistics (freight up from $1.5k to $7.5k-$8k per container) and 30-40% rise in raw material costs (memory, CPUs); Brand margins expected to expand from 13% to 18-19% at scale due to operating leverage (manpower, marketing, logistics cost % reduction); Make-in-India surveillance offers higher gross margins but higher opex initially.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: Prioritizing working capital for inventory buildup amid supply chain disruptions; Debt used for MSME vendor financing (INR 171cr); No equity raise planned unless large acquisition (>30% of current size) emerges; Future demerger of brand business to unlock shareholder value.

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Confident and ambitious; Emphasizes long-term institution building over quarterly noise; Acknowledges near-term logistics/cost headwinds but frames them as temporary; Strong focus on 'Make-in-India' sovereignty in surveillance/drones; Transparent about demerger plans and brand scaling logic.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Distribution reach: omni-channel Pan-India network of 10,000+ channel partners, 18 warehouses with over 125,000 sq. ft., presence across 38+ countries, spanning General Trade, LFR, e-commerce, Quick Commerce, D2C and the Government e-Marketplace
- Switching costs / brand stickiness: many partner brands have appointed Creative Newtech as their exclusive partner and maintained associations for over five years, and the Company has secured long-running contracts with 26+ global brands
- Value-added market-entry capability beyond pure distribution — market intelligence, go-to-market strategy, brand positioning, demand generation and lifecycle support — described as setting it apart from conventional players
- Brand ownership / IP: authorised trademark licensee for Honeywell International Inc., exclusively manufacturing the Honeywell 'Electronic Essentials' range across South Asia, Southeast Asia, Middle East Asia & Africa, plus exclusive rights to manufacture and distribute CyberPowerPC customised gaming and high-performance PCs in India
- Service infrastructure: end-to-end warranty and post-warranty support, high-level repair services and response centres, reinforcing partner-brand confidence
- Supply-chain and customs advantage: AEO-T2 accreditation, Three Star Export House status, a Section 58 Private Bonded Warehouse at Bhiwandi, a modern Warehouse Management System and API integrations with logistics providers
- Channel enablement depth: one of the few large distributors conducting specialised training modules, workshops, demos and ground-level promotional activity for resellers
- Government market access through the GeM platform for large-scale public-sector technology opportunities

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: Middle East conflict prolonging Red Sea route disruptions impacting 14% of revenue; Rising raw material costs (memory/CPU) outpacing price pass-through ability; Receivables bloating (21% of sales) if B2G payment cycles elongate; Dependency on Honeywell license renewal (March 2027); Execution risk in launching own brand in competitive US market.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: MSME vendor financing (INR 171cr) classified as short-term debt but carries low interest (~8.5%), distorting net debt perception; Own-brand 'Vertual' targets US air purifier market ($1B on Amazon alone) where Honeywell license is restricted; Surveillance shift from 'cameras' to 'data collection devices' with AI GPUs creates sticky B2G moat; Demerger timeline (15 months planning + 12-15 months execution) suggests value unlock event in FY28-29.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Three-pronged growth strategy: (1) strengthen leadership as a Market Entry Specialist, (2) new products and platforms — entry into the surveillance space via Sparsh and Matrix, (3) brand licensing and contract manufacturing, leveraging the Honeywell experience to target more brands.
- Strengthen the core Market Entry Specialist platform through market intelligence and go-to-market strategy, Pan-India distribution and channel development, brand positioning and market expansion, retail/enterprise/omnichannel enablement, sales and demand generation, and customer support and lifecycle …

themes.title: Data-Center & AI electrical/cooling buildout
themes.need: AI/data-center capex pulls transformers, switchgear, gensets, HVAC/cooling, optical and cabling AND a new high-margin cooling supply chain. CUMMINSIND flags DC at ~30-35% of domestic powergen with a demand surge since Oct-2025; VENUSPIPES won a ~INR185cr DC-cooling LOI; AEROFLEX building liquid-cooling skids; BLUESTARCO on DC MEP; STLTECH/NETWEB on optical + HPC/AI servers (STLTECH's DC+Enterprise mix hit 21% of Q1FY27 revenue from 1% in FY26 on record INR13,100cr quarterly order intake anchored by a $1.1bn multi-year hyperscaler deal; FY27 EBITDA-margin guide raised 20%->23% and DC+Enterprise mix guide raised 30%->50% of revenue); REDINGTON/DCI/IVALUE on GPU/AI-infra distribution. Q1FY27 added two balance-sheet-scale entrants: HCLTECH is putting up to INR 3,500cr into its own AI-datacenter business with a 50MW long-term ambition ('megawatt isn't the product, it's the anchor'), and RELIANCE disclosed a 168 MW Meta data centre at Jamnagar built on its own balance sheet.
themes.driver: DC cooling LOIs converting (VENUSPIPES, AEROFLEX); hyperscaler/colo India capex (CUMMINSIND gensets, BLUESTARCO MEP); STLTECH's $1.1bn hyperscaler optical-connectivity deal and 2.4x QoQ order-book jump to INR18,618cr; GPU/AI-infra orders.

themes.title: Electronics manufacturing (EMS) & Make-in-India localization
themes.need: PLI + import-substitution + global China+1 sourcing drive an electronics-manufacturing build-out across consumer durables, defence and components. AMBER/PGEL/EPACK/SYRMA/AVALON/CYIENTDLM on box-build/EMS; DIXON-tier scale; CPPLUS/CNL on surveillance; KAYNES/SYRMA on integrated components; appliance ODMs (EPACK, AMBER) ride RAC/white-goods localization.
themes.driver: PLI disbursement + new ODM/OEM program wins; appliance season; defence/aero EMS conversion (AVALON, CYIENTDLM).
